about.title: About
about.body: Junior full-stack developer with an IFTS background and a method I take seriously: TypeScript everywhere, tests before merge, CI/CD and linting as a habit. I like the work you don't see — layered architecture, database-level integrity constraints, security hardening — because that's where a project holds up over time. I build with Angular, Node/Express and Sequelize. I'm looking for a team where I can keep learning and ship code worth trusting.
